sloka: आगमिष्यति दुर्बुद्धिर्व्यक्तं स न भविष्यति ।ये चापि सचिवाः स्तस्य संश्रिता मामकं वनम् ॥४-११-५५॥।।
transliteration: āgamiṣyati durbuddhirvyaktaṁ sa na bhaviṣyati ।ye cāpi sacivāḥ stasya saṁśritā māmakaṁ vanam ॥4-11-55॥।।

translations.english: 'Indeed his counsellors who are here must leave this forest. Let them depart safely.
